title: AfrIFact: Cultural Information Retrieval, Evidence Extraction and Fact Checking for African Languages
abstract: arXiv:2604.00706v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Assessing the veracity of a claim made online is a complex and important task with real-world implications. When these claims are directed at communities with limited access to information and the content concerns issues such as healthcare and culture, the consequences intensify, especially in low-resource languages. In this work, we introduce AfrIFact, a dataset that covers the necessary steps for automatic fact-checking (i.e., information retrieval, evidence extraction, and fact checking), in ten African languages and English. Our evaluation results show that even the best embedding models lack cross-lingual retrieval capabilities, and that cultural and news documents are easier to retrieve than healthcare-domain documents, both in large corpora and in single documents. We show that LLMs lack robust multilingual fact-verification capabilities in African languages, while few-shot prompting improves performance by up to 43% in Afriqu

translated_title: AfrIFact：面向非洲语言的文化信息检索、证据提取与事实核查
translated_abstract: 评估网络上所做声明的真实性是一项复杂且重要的任务，具有现实世界的影响。当这些声明指向信息获取有限的社区，且内容涉及医疗健康和文化等问题时，其后果会更加严重，尤其是在低资源语言中。在这项工作中，我们介绍了AfrIFact，这是一个涵盖自动事实核查所需步骤（即信息检索、证据提取和事实核查）的数据集，覆盖十种非洲语言和英语。我们的评估结果表明，即使是最好的嵌入模型也缺乏跨语言检索能力，而且无论是在大型语料库还是单个文档中，文化和新闻类文档都比医疗健康领域的文档更容易被检索到。我们还表明，大语言模型在非洲语言方面缺乏稳健的多语言事实验证能力，而少样本提示可以将性能提升高达43%。
tldr: 本文提出了AfrIFact数据集，覆盖十种非洲语言和英语的自动事实核查全流程（信息检索、证据提取与事实核查），并揭示现有嵌入模型缺乏跨语言检索能力、大语言模型在非洲语言事实验证上表现不佳，而少样本提示可将性能提升高达43%。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces AfrIFact, a dataset covering the full automatic fact-checking pipeline (information retrieval, evidence extraction, and fact checking) across ten African languages and English, revealing that even the best embedding models lack cross-lingual retrieval capabilities and LLMs lack robust multilingual fact-verification in African languages, though few-shot prompting improves performance by up to 43%.
